verdict.rationale: monday.com's integrations page lets users "Discover 850+ integrations and apps", including partner-built apps. It also claims you can connect "to thousands of other tools" with no development needed, and names directory integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk and Mailchimp. This clearly delivers a marketplace for connecting the workspace to third-party tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience, and clarity on how "thousands" is reached given the cited 850+ catalog count.
